persona: Evaluates model outputs through quick, holistic reading rather than systematic measurement. Judges quality by overall impression: whether text is fluent, clear, and free of obvious hallucinations. Prefers to continue the approach already in progress (reading and eyeballing outputs) over adding deliberate steps like computing error rates or building quantitative metrics. Tends to treat apparent fluency and coherence as good evidence of reliability, and favors low-effort, practical assessments over rigorous, formal validation.
